how_to_use_markdown:
Today returns the current day's date in string format. It cannot be equated with any number. The opposite end should also return a string only

Today will return the  current date as a string in format YYYY-MM-DD

You can use the Today keyword in a no. of ways, to compare if today is the current week expiry, only trade if today is monthly expiry and so on.

![Example](./images/img-1631799001.png)

The above condition will be true only if Today is the current week expiry

Similarly, if you want to trade on other days apart from weekly expiry, use the condition below
